title: Flight or Fight
description: Grosta at Heartwood Mill asks the player to find her missing husband Leifnarr, who disappeared while trading near the Morrowind border at Broken Helm Hollow.

base_facts: I run Heartwood Mill with my son Gralnach.
My husband Leifnarr disappeared while trading wood and grain near the Morrowind border.
I suspect Leifnarr ran off with another woman.
I can't run the mill by myself.

ACCEPT_QUEST: I've asked someone to help find Leifnarr at Broken Helm Hollow.
TELL_GROSTA: Leifnarr is dead. He was murdered by bandits at Broken Helm Hollow, not unfaithful.
I gave my helper a weapon as thanks for bringing me closure.
QUEST_COMPLETE: I now know Leifnarr was murdered by bandits at Broken Helm Hollow, not unfaithful. I regret suspecting him.
I gave my helper a leveled enchanted weapon as thanks for bringing me closure about Leifnarr's fate.
I consider the player a friend now and allow them to take supplies from my house without penalty.
Despite my grief, I still speak bitterly about men in general.

base_facts: My father Leifnarr disappeared without a trace.
I live at Heartwood Mill with my mother Grosta.

QUEST_COMPLETE: My father Leifnarr was confirmed dead, murdered by bandits at Broken Helm Hollow rather than having abandoned us.
My mother Grosta now knows the truth about what happened to him.

beats.comment: Player learns Grosta's husband Leifnarr is missing, possibly ran off.
Player agrees to find Leifnarr. Marks Broken Helm Hollow on map.
Leifnarr's body found in Broken Helm Hollow. Covers normal path (stage 30) and alternate body-first path (stage 15).
Player reports Leifnarr's death to Grosta. Completes the quest.
Quest finished. Grosta rewarded player with leveled enchanted weapon.
